solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, mirror symmetry); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: He's done wrong misrepresenting strangers? So right

indicators.note: to misrepresent is to present falsely, so the letters of the words that follow are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone muses that a person who twisted the words of strangers might, for that reason, be in the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misrepresenting' reshuffles STRANGERS into TRANSGRES; SO as written and R for right then close the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrongdoer, a person who has broken a law or rule, is exactly someone who has done wrong.

clue.text: Unwanted strikers are put on this?

definitions.text: Unwanted strikers are put on this?

parts.words: Unwanted strikers are put on this?
parts.note: strikers suggests workers on strike, but in football a striker is a forward; a club offers players it no longer wants on a published register of those available to other clubs

explanation.surface: It sounds like a blacklist for troublesome workers who have downed tools.
explanation.walkthrough: In football, a club places players it is willing to sell on a list of those available for other clubs to buy.
explanation.definitionFit: Footballers a club wishes to sell, such as surplus forwards, are formally listed as available for a move elsewhere.

clue.text: Contents of farm vegetable store

indicators.note: the contents of a word are what lies inside it, so the outer letters are dropped and the middle kept

parts.note: a chive is a small onion-like plant used as a vegetable herb

explanation.surface: A farmer stores the vegetables from the farm somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contents of' strips F and M from farm, leaving AR.
explanation.definitionFit: A repository where records are kept is a place of storage for documents.

clue.text: Digger's card

definitions.meaning: read as 'digger is': a tool for digging the garden
a playing card of the suit marked with black leaf-shaped pips

explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe-s is 'is', joining the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The garden tool and the playing card of that black suit share one name.

clue.text: Competitor — one in luxury car…

indicators.note: the word in places one piece within another, here the card for one inside the car

parts.note: RR is short for Rolls-Royce, the luxury car maker
an ace is the card counting as one

explanation.surface: A competitor sits in a luxury car, perhaps a rally driver.
explanation.walkthrough: RR is a common crossword abbreviation for Rolls-Royce.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who runs or drives in a race is a competitor in it.

clue.text: …less important car? Nod "yes" sadly

indicators.note: something gone sadly wrong is in a bad state, so the letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: Continuing from the previous clue, someone nods a gloomy yes to the idea that their car matters less.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of second rank is subordinate, of lesser importance than the main thing.

clue.text: Gig — doing ten? Shan't unfortunately

indicators.note: an unfortunate turn of events messes things up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A performer refuses to play ten dates in a row.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' rearranges DOING TEN SHANT, ignoring the apostrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: A single performance in one town before the band moves on is a typical musician's booking or engagement.

clue.text: Clergyman in park on hill

parts.note: REC is short for recreation ground, a British public park
a tor is a rocky hill, especially on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: A priest is found in a park on a hill.
explanation.walkthrough: A rec is a recreation ground, a British public playing field; a tor is a rocky hilltop in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: A parish priest in the Church of England holding the living is a member of the clergy.

clue.text: Out of date leading article I initially cut

parts.note: arch as an adjective means chief or leading, as in arch-villain
a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: An editor cuts an outdated lead article.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leading article' looks like a newspaper editorial, but splits into ARCH and A.
explanation.definitionFit: Something antiquated, belonging to an earlier era, is old-fashioned and obsolete.

clue.text: Fabric salesman introduced to church

indicators.note: one piece brought into another is placed within it

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a rep is a sales representative

explanation.surface: A cloth salesman makes his pitch to a church.
explanation.walkthrough: CE is the Church of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin crinkled cloth, often silk, is a type of textile.

clue.text: Leaders of strong parties, if necessary, exhibit backbone

indicators.note: the leaders of words are their opening letters, taken from each of the five that follow

explanation.surface: Heads of powerful political parties should show some steel when needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaders of' takes the first letter of each of the next five words.
explanation.definitionFit: The vertebral column is the backbone; figuratively both also mean courage.

clue.text: Manage port, given time to grow profusely

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A harbour manager is given time to expand the port greatly.
explanation.definitionFit: Plants that spread wildly and without control are said to flourish unchecked, an idiom for abundant growth.

clue.text: Like two originally trying high jump, say

parts.note: two is an even number

indicators.note: originally points to the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Two athletes are both attempting the high jump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' marks the high jump as just one example of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The high jump is one contest in an athletics meeting, an example of a sporting competition.

clue.text: Swimsuit container popular on island

parts.note: a tank is a container for liquid
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A swimsuit in a box goes down well on a holiday island.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-piece swimming costume with a vest-style top is a kind of swimwear.

clue.text: Sergeant major hears about outstanding person

indicators.note: about means around in a jumbled way, so the letters of the next word are moved round

explanation.surface: A sergeant major hears about a star soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang, a smasher is a delightful or excellent person.

clue.text: Old Greek box, brown

parts.note: to spar is to box in practice
tan is a light brown

explanation.surface: An ancient Greek is pictured with a brown box, or boxing with a tan.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Sparta, the ancient city-state, was a Greek of the classical era.

clue.text: Famous stage close by a railway

parts.note: a leg is a stage of a journey or race
a close is an end

explanation.surface: A well-known stage sits near a railway line.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone so celebrated that stories are told of them is renowned, well known.

clue.text: Become angry, stare, when nothing's brought in

indicators.note: one letter brought in to a word is put inside it

parts.note: to gape is to stare open-mouthed
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone flies into a rage, glaring, when nothing is delivered.
explanation.definitionFit: To lose one's temper wildly is an informal idiom for getting furious.

clue.text: Work with needles, thus, it's reported

indicators.note: something reported is spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: so means thus, in this way

explanation.surface: Someone is told to use needles in this way, according to reports.
explanation.definitionFit: Stitching with needle and thread is the basic needlework skill.

clue.text: After tips from Welsh, devour farm product

indicators.note: the tips of a word are its two ends, its first and last letters

parts.note: to devour is to eat

explanation.surface: After advice from a Welshman, someone tucks into produce from the farm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tips' looks like advice, but means the ends of Welsh, W and H.
explanation.definitionFit: The cereal grain grown for flour is a staple crop of arable farms.

clue.text: Insult awfully pleasant chief

indicators.note: done awfully means done badly, so the letters are put in a disordered arrangement

explanation.surface: A boss who is terribly nice can still give offence.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuff or affront, figuratively a blow to someone's cheek, is an insult.

clue.text: Finally lose black bishop, fall away

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the next word

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A chess player at last gives up his black bishop and his position crumbles.
explanation.definitionFit: The tide's retreat gives the sense of declining or receding, dwindling away.

clue.text: Group of soldiers in region changing direction at first

indicators.note: the first letter is a direction, right, and it is switched to the other one, left

explanation.surface: A unit of troops in a region is moved to a new direction early on.
explanation.walkthrough: The R of region stands for right; 'changing direction at first' swaps it for L, left.
explanation.definitionFit: A Roman military unit of several thousand men is a body of soldiers.

clue.text: I'd invested in wager — cleaned out here?

indicators.note: something invested in a place is put inside it, here the contracted word placed in the wager

parts.note: a bet is a wager

explanation.surface: A gambler who staked everything on a bet was cleaned out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cleaned out' suggests losing all one's money on the wager; read literally, it is where someone washes their bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: A low basin for washing one's private parts is literally a place of personal cleansing.
